name.en: “Hi Mum, hi Dad”: a text from your child asking for money

how.en: A text from an unknown number claims to be from your adult son or daughter. It says there is an emergency, such as a lost or broken phone, and asks you to send money quickly. The scam started on WhatsApp and is now back as plain text messages. The money goes to the scammer.

text.en: A text from an unknown number says it is your son or daughter.
They say this is their new number because something happened to their phone.
They describe an emergency and ask you to send money now.
Hi Mum it's me, I've lost my phone so this is my new number. Can you text me back? I need a favour, it's urgent x
Hi Dad, my phone's broken and I can't get into my banking app. Can you pay a bill for me today? I'll pay you back tomorrow

en: hi dad text asking for money
son texted from a new number
daughter lost her phone asked for money
pay a bill for my child urgently
message from my kid on unknown number
A relative writing from a number you don’t know.
An emergency and a request for money straight away.
They can’t talk on the phone.
Call your relative on the number you already have before doing anything.
Ask a question only they would know, or agree a family password.
Forward the text free to 7726. If you paid, call your bank straight away (you can dial 159).
